title: Underrepresented in Foundation Model Pretraining Data? A One-Shot Probe

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification accuracy on datasets sourced from the Global South (e.g., African Food, Beans) compared to standard Western-centric benchmarks (e.g., ImageNet, CIFAR) to identify performance disparities due to training data provenance.

Assessing the model's ability to recognize culturally specific concepts (e.g., traditional African dishes) using a counterfactual probing method that distinguishes true descriptions from semantically plausible but incorrect distractors.
